prize_parts.citation: for discovering that liquid-liquid phase separation organizes the interior of living cells into biomolecular condensates
for the design of ionizable lipid nanoparticles that enable delivery of nucleic-acid medicines

statement.case_for: Biomolecular condensates brought phase behaviour, multivalency, interfaces and non-equilibrium dynamics into cell biology. The founding observation, that P granules behave as liquids, is unambiguously attributable to Hyman and Brangwynne, and more than a decade of independent confirmation supports the physical picture. Ionizable lipid nanoparticles are a lipid self-assembly problem solved by chemistry: pH-dependent charge and phase behaviour let nucleic acids be encapsulated, delivered and released. Both are physical-chemical principles whose consequences are felt well beyond chemistry, and the two together make a prize with two distinct achievements and a plain citation each. I do not claim that the opening tally supports this pairing; I am arguing from scientific substance, and I accept that B029 has far broader committee support than either part.
statement.case_against: Phase separation in vivo is still contested: which cellular assemblies are genuine equilibrium phase-separated liquids rather than other assemblies is unresolved, and a prize could appear to endorse an over-extended claim. The field may also be judged as belonging to cell biology. For B006 the three-name cap forces me to drop Hope, Madden, Langer, Anderson and MacLachlan, and the 2023 Medicine prize on mRNA overlaps the application. Singling out Cullis alone is a defensible but imperfect reading of a crowded lineage.

responses.point: B029 (PROTACs and molecular glues) is a genuinely new pharmacological modality, built on induced proximity, with a mechanistic foundation confirmed over two decades and many clinical-stage degraders.
responses.response: I agree the chemical idea is original and well confirmed, and I rank it highly enough to keep it as my first alternative. My hesitation is that no degrader is yet approved, so the therapeutic case still rests on promise, and the credit divides between the PROTAC strand and the cereblon glue strand. Compare that with condensates, where the founding observation is cleaner. I would not oppose B029 if the committee can settle attribution between Crews, Deshaies, Handa and Ciulli, but I do not think it is clearly ahead on scientific maturity.

responses.point: B056 (long-range electron transfer through proteins) provides a quantitative physical framework for respiration and photosynthesis, with a clean Gray-Winkler pair and decades of confirmation.
responses.response: It is attractive for its clarity and clean attribution, and I take seriously that membrane-protein energy conversion is a mechanistic achievement. My qualification is that Marcus theory was recognised in 1992 and the tunnelling-map work is closer to a rigorous refinement of that framework than a new concept, which weakens the case for originality. Condensates and lipid delivery seem to me to open more new chemistry. I would put B056 behind them, though I could be persuaded if the committee values mechanistic completeness over breadth.

responses.point: B043 (Pd-catalyzed C-N cross-coupling) has very large lasting impact on synthesis, a fair two-person attribution to Buchwald and Hartwig, and is arguably overdue, though the 2010 cross-coupling prize may make members cautious.
responses.response: I agree that the impact and attribution are strong, and as a synthetic chemist your reading of the field should carry weight with me. My concern is the one you raise yourself: it extends a method already honoured in 2010, so the conceptual step is smaller than for the other candidates. I would rather reserve scarce prize slots for achievements that open a new area. That is a judgement about novelty, not a negative view of the work, and I would not block it.

responses.point: B047 (base editing) is a clear invention with chemically driven deaminase engineering, already in clinical use, and timely, though it overlaps with the 2020 CRISPR prize and with prime editing.
responses.response: The chemistry of deaminase engineering is real and I rank it on my list, but I share your worry about the 2020 CRISPR overlap and the prime-editing question. A prize here would be read as an extension of that award, and whether it belongs in Chemistry rather than Medicine is not settled. I disagree on timing: I think condensates and lipid delivery have a stronger claim to being a distinct, completed contribution at this stage.

responses.point: B058 (halide perovskite solar cells) turned a solution-processed ionic semiconductor into a near-silicon absorber, with Miyasaka, Park and Snaith as the originators, and independent reproduction across hundreds of groups.
responses.response: I agree that the science is strong and I ranked it third, so it is my second alternative. The three-name cut is hard, because Grätzel, Seok and Kanatzidis also contributed, and long-term stability and lead toxicity remain open. I think that leaves it slightly behind condensates on conceptual breadth, but I would support it if the committee wants a materials and energy prize.

uncertainties: Whether biomolecular condensates in vivo are equilibrium phase separation, and whether the field will be judged chemistry rather than biology.
Allocation within B055: whether Rosen, Pappu or Mittag should displace one of Hyman and Brangwynne under the three-person cap.
Whether crediting Cullis alone fairly represents the Vancouver lipid lineage given the mRNA vaccine overlap with the 2023 Medicine prize.
Whether the committee will prefer B029 on breadth of support once attribution between the PROTAC and molecular glue strands is resolved.
statement.conflict_note: My profile records no direct tie to any shortlisted candidate, but I work on lipid self-assembly and lipid-protein co-assembly, so I have scientific proximity to B055 and B006 and should be transparent about it. I also share Lund with Linke and Somfai, and field overlap with Aili and Brzezinski. No specific conflict requiring recusal is apparent from the provided profile.
